# PUT /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/variables/{variablename}

Update a repo-level variable

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-270`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| variablename | path | string | True |

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `UpdateVariableOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `name` | string | False | must match ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$, must not start with GITEA_ or GITHUB_ |
| `value` | string | True | max 65536 runes |
| `description` | string | False | truncated to 4096 runes |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **400** — Invalid variable name
- **404** — Variable not found

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Variable name must match pattern ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$ (case insensitive) | validation | !namePattern.MatchString(name) |
| Variable name must not start with GITEA_ or GITHUB_ prefix | validation | forbiddenPrefixPattern.MatchString(name) |
| Variable name must not be 'CI' (reserved) | validation | strings.EqualFold(name, "CI") |
| Variable data must not exceed 65536 runes | validation | utf8.RuneCountInString(data) > VariableDataMaxLength |
| Variable description is truncated to 4096 runes on insert/update | business_logic | Always applied |
| Variable name is stored uppercase | business_logic | Always applied on insert and update |

### Error Paths

- **Variable not found** → Action.UpdateVariable → 404
- **Invalid name** → actions_service.UpdateVariableNameData → 400
- **Data too long (>65536 runes)** → actions_model.UpdateVariableCols → 400
